item.title: A stormwater pond in Calgary appears filled with Prussian carp; the invasive fish can produce...
item.description: In Calgary, invasive Prussian carp are infiltrating the stormwater system, creating a serious threat to local ecology. These fish breed swiftly, endangering aquatic life and city infrastructure. Simultaneously, encounters with elk in Canadian parks are becoming more perilous than those with bears due to their massive size and unpredictable behavior, prompting authorities to implement management strategies to confront both wildlife conflicts and invasive species.

item.title: An 11-year-old boy cried after his first customer rejection; weeks later, his $10 business...
item.description: A young Canadian entrepreneur, just eleven years old, started a trash-bin cleaning service to earn some pocket money. His venture quickly attracted a large social media following and a multitude of clients, particularly during a tough summer job market for teens. With plans to keep the business growing into the colder months, he stands as an inspiring example for children worldwide to initiate their own entrepreneurial journeys.

item.title: The Chinese bahaba, a critically endangered fish was missing from Hong Kong for over a decade
item.description: A recent study has confirmed the presence of the rare Chinese bahaba in Hong Kong's waters through genetic material extracted from seawater. Nicknamed the 'Panda of the Sea,' this critically endangered fish had evaded scientific capture for over ten years. Researchers utilized cutting-edge environmental DNA technology, revealing traces of the fish's DNA across various western bays, thereby advancing non-invasive methods for marine population monitoring and conservation.

item.title: This Airbnb looks like a ship, has a secret treasure room and earns $80,000. Now it's for sale
item.description: Nestled in Salmon, Idaho, a captivating pirate-themed house is on the market for $799,000, boasting a remarkable annual income of around $80,000 from its Airbnb bookings. The property stands out amidst a collection of luxurious and historic homes detailed in market reports. Economic shifts are shaping the landscape of luxury real estate, with affluent baby boomers opting for more spacious residences as they transition into retirement.

item.title: Romania shoots down third suspected Russian drone in three days, summons Moscow's envoy
item.description: Romania shot down a drone entering its airspace over the Black Sea. This marked the third such interception in as many days. President Nicusor Dan condemned these repeated violations as intolerable and unacceptable. Romania summoned the Russian ambassador to protest these airspace breaches. Investigations are ongoing into the drone incidents and border tensions are high.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Slash-and-burn farming was blamed for destroying rainforests, but a study something different
item.description: In various small communities, unwritten agreements are crucial for sustainable land management. These norms not only restrict deforestation, fostering forest regeneration, but also bolster biodiversity by allowing flora and fauna to thrive. Research highlights the effectiveness of these traditions in safeguarding forest health over time. It is essential for policymakers to support and uphold these local practices for robust environmental conservation.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: These fish are born female & later become male; fishing may be changing them at molecular level
item.description: A new study has found that heavy fishing may be changing pearly razorfish at the molecular level. Researchers found no major changes in the fish's DNA but discovered differences in DNA methylation, an epigenetic process that affects how genes work. The study also found that marine reserves help preserve larger, older fish and maintain higher genetic diversity.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Conservationists filled a 1.2km river channel, new Somerset wetland now attracts rare wildlife
item.description: A river restoration project in Somerset, UK, has shown major benefits within a year of completion. By reconnecting the River Aller with its floodplain, researchers found reduced flood peaks, cleaner water, higher groundwater levels and a sharp rise in wetland habitat. The restored landscape has also attracted more wildlife, including fish, birds and water voles.

item.title: Baby crib sent flying, 800,000 flee: Typhoon Noul hits China; scary visuals emerge
item.description: Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China's Guangdong province early Sunday. More than 800,000 people were relocated to safer areas in Guangdong. Hong Kong experienced significant transport chaos with hundreds of flights cancelled. Dramatic videos of the storm's impact quickly went viral on social media. The typhoon weakened inland but heavy rain threats continue through Tuesday.

item.title: Five novelty chocolates recalled across Britain over undeclared milk and soya allergens
item.description: The UK Food Standards Agency has recalled several Bon Bons Wholesale chocolate products because they contain undeclared milk and soya. People with allergies to either ingredient are advised not to eat the chocolates and should return them to the store for a full refund. The recall covers products sold across England, Scotland and Wales.

item.title: Scientists used AI to analyse 116,000 birdsongs, identify eight common motifs
item.description: Scientists have identified eight common sound patterns that form the basis of birdsong after analysing more than 116,000 recordings from 3,160 songbird species worldwide. The study found that birds living in different habitats sing differently because forests, open landscapes and the way sound travels influence which songs work best, alongside evolution.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Quote of the day by Hulk Hogan: "If I have a problem with someone I talk about them. I don't…" - a lesson on respect, accountability and keeping personal conflicts where they belong
item.description: Disagreements should remain focused on the individuals involved in the conflict. Hulk Hogan's quote emphasizes not involving children in adult disputes. Containing arguments to the original issue prevents unnecessary harm and wider complications. Direct communication and taking responsibility build trust and aid resolution. This principle applies broadly, urging focus on behavior and ideas, not personal attacks.
